test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

This is the ground which is _______ to be the highest cricket ground in the world.
solution:
The correct answer is **considered**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**The meaning of:

__
 
• **Considered:** to think about somebody/something in a particular way. (किसी के बारे में किसी विशेष तरीके से सोचना)

 
 
• 
 **For example,** He considered that the risk was too great.
 
 
 
 
• Therefore, from the meaning given above, the correct word is 'Considered.'
 
• Hence, the correct option is 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
 The meaning of: 

 
 
• 
 **Cleared:** to remove something that is not wanted. (किसी ऐसी चीज़ को हटाना जो वांछित न हो।)

 
 
• 
 **For example,** to clear the roads of snow/to clear snow from the roads.
 
 
 
 
• 
 **Concealed: **to hide something. (कुछ छिपाना।)

 
 
• 
 **For example,** She tried to conceal her anger from her friend.
 
 
 
 
• 
 **Covered:** to put something on or in front of something to hide or protect it. ( किसी चीज को छिपाने या बचाने के लिए उसके ऊपर या सामने रखना।)

 
 
• 
 **For example,** I covered the floor with newspaper before I started painting.
 
 
 
 
 
 

38:T632,
The correct answer is **'No substitution required.'**</spa
